description: Pinned toolchains for every Linux ELF the project builds. A build that cannot verify this pin must not produce a public artifact. Verified with: python3 -B framework/nxabi/nxabi.py toolchain

armv7-gcc.role: primary ARMHF compiler for universal-low-glibc artifacts
armv7-gcc.version_full: arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc (GNU Toolchain for the A-profile Architecture 8.2-2018-08 (arm-rel-8.23)) 8.2.1 20180802
armv7-gcc.measured_floor_note: minimal hello/libm fixture links at GLIBC_2.4 with EABI5 hard-float and /lib/ld-linux-armhf.so.3

armv7-clang.role: second ARMHF compiler; proves the code is not GCC-only
armv7-clang.canonical_flags_note: Clang needs BOTH --gcc-toolchain (for crtbeginS.o and libgcc) and -fuse-ld=lld. Without --gcc-toolchain the link fails with 'cannot find crtbeginS.o'; with the host ld it fails with 'unrecognised emulation mode armelf_linux_eabi'.

aarch64-buster-container.role: only local low-glibc AArch64 toolchain; the host aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc requires GLIBC_2.34 and is disqualified

host-aarch64-gcc.reason: sysroot /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu ships glibc 2.44; a minimal fixture already requires GLIBC_2.34, above the public ceiling 2.30

host-gcc.reason: x86_64 host compiler; only valid for host-side test builds, never for a packaged artifact

non_hermetic_recipes.note: These historical approved-reference recipes still install compilers over the network or use moving image tags. They are read-only evidence and are not accepted inputs to the closed M17 framework gate. Any future rebuild/public release that touches one must first migrate it to a pinned offline toolchain and produce new bytes for revalidation.
